entries.note: One program serves every command: mode 0 is a plain quad (rects, frame highlight) with no feather so current-UI scenes stay pixel-exact against the SDL reference; modes 1-3 evaluate a rounded-box signed distance in drawable pixels with a one-pixel feather (fill), an outer-minus-inner band (ring, also the 1px frame border) and a smoothstep falloff over the shadow width; mode 4 samples the coverage atlas, mode 5 an RGBA texture. Per-corner radii come from the corner mask so tabs can round only their top. This is the anti-aliased behaviour the owner chose in spec 068; Metal and Vulkan reuse the same shader logic.

entries.note: Glyph quads land at x*density+dx and (y+ascent+2)*density+dy, which is exactly where the SDL reference's float rectangle scales to at integer density, and the atlas is sampled with GL_NEAREST at texel-aligned coordinates, so text is compared under the tight current-UI tolerance. The atlas is a single 2048² R8 texture packed on shelves; when it fills, the batch is flushed and the atlas repacked from scratch instead of growing, keeping memory bounded. Blending uses separate alpha factors to reproduce SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND. Changing any of this changes the comparison numbers in the evidence.
